data.name: Illusive Revenge
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day, you can cast phantasmal revenge (APG p.235) as a spell-like ability upon a recently slain creature, which rises as a ghastly image to seek out its killer. This illusive ghost is always veiled, even if it never was so in life. After the target attempts its Will saving throw (DC %1), regardless of whether the attempt was successful, the ghost tears off its veil to reveal an image of the killer's own face.|17+CHA
